name: Berglsteiner See
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Berglsteiner at 713 m above sea level: a hidden forest lake natural monument between Breitenbach and Kramsach with a circular path, sunbathing lawn, and restaurant.
beschreibung:
Overview

The dreamy Lake Berglsteiner, a strictly protected natural jewel in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley, lies at 714 meters above sea level, hidden in a sheltered wooded hollow between Kramsach and Breitenbach am Inn. Surrounded by steep rock formations, dense mixed mountain forest, and ancient trees, the body of water enchants with its intense emerald green color and its mirror-smooth surface. For generations, this idyllic forest lake has been a soothing retreat for nature enthusiasts, passionate photographers, and those seeking tranquility, who wish to experience an unspoiled alpine oasis away from the large tourist crowds and observe the rich animal and plant life.

Route & Requirements

A leisurely, incredibly scenic circular path leads directly along the natural, densely wooded lakeshore through sparse spruce and beech stands and can be circumnavigated in about 45 minutes without rushing. The tranquil hike has no significant ascents at any point, is excellently maintained, and is ideal for family outings with children, seniors, older holidaymakers, and nature-loving recreation seekers of all ages who appreciate the tranquility of the forest. Along the shady forest path, numerous lovingly placed wooden benches invite you to pause and admire the fascinating play of colors on the water. The route requires no alpine experience; comfortable, sturdy leisure footwear is perfectly sufficient for the flat, natural forest path and the short rooty sections.

Visit & Arrival

The lake is freely accessible all year round and unfolds its unique charm in every season: in summer as a welcome forest resting place with opportunities for refreshment in the cool water, in autumn surrounded by vibrant autumn colors, and in snowy winter as a dreamy backdrop for quiet winter hikes. Arrival is via the Inntal motorway A12 to the Kramsach or Brixlegg exit and then towards Breitenbach. From the paid car park Moosen or Reintalersee, a well-signposted forest and hiking trail leads gently uphill to the shore in about twenty minutes on foot.

Tips

Directly on the sunny shore, the traditional Restaurant Berglsteinersee welcomes its guests with an idyllic wooden terrace directly above the water. Here, regional Tyrolean home cooking, freshly caught trout, crisp summer salads, and wonderfully fragrant, homemade cakes with fresh coffee are served. On warm days, be sure to pack your swimwear to refresh yourself in the crystal-clear mountain water at the designated sunbathing lawn, and combine the excursion with a light circular hike via Lake Krummsee to the neighboring Lake Reintaler.
preis: Lake and circular path freely accessible, no charge
